title: hypericum ciliatum var. latifolium
intro: Hypericum ciliatum var. latifolium, commonly known as Broad-leaved St. John's Wort, is a plant species belonging to the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, aiding in wound healing and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to inhibit the reuptake of neurotransmitters like serotonin and dopamine, exhibiting antidepressant properties, as well as its antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum ciliatum var. latifolium include flavonoids, hypericin, and hyperforin, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
